newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utils sees Comanche 2 back Tues-Wed.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utils sees Comanche 2 back Tues-Wed.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co said Monday it expects its 1,150 megawatt (MW) Comanche Peak 2 nuclear power plant to restart on Tuesday or Wednesday, resuming full output within a couple of days.
The unit was shut Saturday to repair a main feedwater valve.
"The unit is expected to begin startup late tomorrow or early Wednesday, be back at 100 percent late Thursday or Friday," said company spokewoman Pat Nichols.
The nearby Comanche Peak unit 1 with identical generating capacity was operating at full power.
The Comanche Peak units in Glen Rose, Texas, produce about 18 percent of the company's electricity deliveries.
